name: Source integrity
test: Every input row carries a URL, a tier and a capture time; the results feed reconciles 32/32 against the official standings

name: Pre-registration
test: The family's rule file exists, its sha256 matches the ledger, and its registration predates the first graded bet

name: Verified price
test: Opening and closing prices from an official or named-operator source exist for the market

name: No lookahead
test: Every forecast is produced from games strictly before its own week, and the forecast file records train_last_week

name: Sample adequacy
test: Prospective graded bets >= 300 per family (the power note fixes that number before results); n is published

name: Multiplicity
test: Holm adjustment across all registered families, with the family count published

name: Calibration
test: Market-relative skill is positive with a cluster-bootstrap lower bound above zero

name: Joint probability
test: A parlay or prop combo is ranked only where a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both present

name: Availability evidence
test: Personnel enters only from official, timestamped observations; ablations replace fixed penalties

name: Demotion
test: A live strategy has a written trigger that returns it to paper

name: Control baselines
test: Every leaderboard run carries random-pick and favourites-only controls graded the same way

name: Persistence outside the design
test: The edge is re-measured on a season not used to design the rule
